description: This file defines permission-related data structures and utility functions for handling permission endpoints and methods within a system. It includes an interface for permission information, a map of permission endpoint patterns to descriptions, and functions to determine HTTP methods and parse permission strings into structured objects.

methods.name: getMethodForEndpoint
methods.description: Determines the HTTP method ('GET' or 'POST') based on the permission endpoint pattern.

methods.name: getPermissionInfo
methods.description: Parses a permission string to produce a PermissionInfo object with method, endpoint, description, and route.
